sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:195201
Court No. - 66
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 39604 of 2024

Applicant :- Basirullah Ahmad
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Ashok Kumar Shukla,Smita Shukla

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Sarvesh Kumar Singh
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.

Heard Sri Ashok Kumar Shukla, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Sarvesh Kumar Singh,
learned counsel for the informant and Sri Santosh Pandey, learned AGA for the State.

2. The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant with the prayer to release her on bail in Case Crime No. 195 of 2024, under Sections 498A and 304B IPC and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Ubhaon, District Ballia during pendency of the trial.

3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is father-in-law of the deceased and on the basis of false allegation of demand of dowry and torture, he has been made accused in the present matter along with his family members including husband of the deceased.

4. He further submits that actually applicant residing separately along with his wife and other family members and this fact is evident from the certificate issued by Gram Pradhan dated 23.08.2024,
which is annexed as page no. 57 of the paper book.

Basirullah Ahmad vs State Of U.P. on 11 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/68658519/
1 5.

entities.text: Basirullah Ahmad vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He next submits that being father-in-law of the deceased, applicant was not having any concern with her family affairs of deceased and it appears that some dispute arose between the husband and the wife thereafter wife consumed some insecticides and died.

6. He further submits, bail application of mother-in-law of the deceased has already been allowed by this Court vide order dated 07.11.2024 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 37070 of 2024 and on facts, case of applicant is at par with her.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 37070 of 2024
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: 7. He further submits that there is no specific allegation against the applicant and he is not having any previous criminal history and in the present matter he is in jail since 21.07.2024, i.e. for the last more than four months.

8. Per contra, learned AGA as well as learned counsel for the informant, however, opposed the prayer for bail and submits that applicant is father-in-law of the deceased and his daughter-in-law died within seven years of marriage under abnormal circumstances and there is allegation of demand of dowry but could not dispute the fact that there is no specific allegation against the applicant and bail application of mother-in-law of the deceased has already been allowed by this Court.
9. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

10. However, daughter-in-law of the applicant died within seven years of her marriage under abnormal circumstances and there is also allegation of demand of dowry but applicant is father-in-law of the deceased and there is no specific allegation against him.
11. Further, bail application of mother-in-law of the deceased has already been allowed by this Court and on facts, case of applicant is at par with her.

12. Further, applicant is not having any previous criminal history and in the present matter he is in jail since 21.07.2024, i.e. for the last more than four months.
13.

Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case discussed above, in my view,
applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
14. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

15. Let the applicant-Basirullah Ahmad be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless her personal presence is exempted.
Basirullah Ahmad vs State Of U.P. on 11 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/68658519/
2

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: (ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade her from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
16. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

17. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
